name: hud_sensor_tracker_zar_mission_late_restore_callback
description: HudSensorTracker::ZarMissionLate_RestoreCallback replays the LOAD_GAME_START animation list from StartAnims.zrd after late mission restore. Direct production host: mission.cpp.
known_limits: Tier C only; no VC COFF byte-comparison target exists yet, so tier S remains open.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja disassembly and decompilation at 0x4176d0 show the fastcall callback loading the tracker userdata, pushing "StartAnims.zrd" and "LOAD_GAME_START", calling HudSensorTracker::RunStartAnimsFromZrd, and returning with three stack arguments cleaned.
HudSensorTracker::RunStartAnimsFromZrd is dependency-ready and functional-equivalent for the start-animation replay contract.

The native callback smoke stages a mounted StartAnims.zrd containing LOAD_GAME_START, invokes ZarMissionLate_RestoreCallback, and verifies the named zEffect animation entry has prerequisites reset, activation queued, and velocity zeroed.
vc5_attempt: python tools/recoil.py verify vc5 --explain-missing 0x4176d0 reported no VC verification target currently covers this address.
